memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him." - Gen 41:8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Troubled by his dreams, Pharaoh calls in the best minds Egypt had to offer — "all the magicians and wise men." Egypt was famous for its learning, its priests, its libraries of dream-lore. If anyone could crack the mystery, surely these experts could. Yet the verse ends with a blunt failure: "no one could interpret them for him." All the wisdom of the world's greatest civilization came up empty.

This is a quiet but pointed reminder: there are things human wisdom simply cannot reach. For all our knowledge, cleverness, and expertise, we come to the edge of mysteries we cannot solve on our own — the meaning of life, the future, the deep questions of the soul. The wise men of Egypt could not see what God alone could reveal.

Our age, like Egypt, prides itself on knowledge and expertise. And human wisdom is a real gift, useful in its place. But it has limits. When it comes to knowing God, understanding His purposes, and grasping the things that matter most, we need something more than our own cleverness — we need God to reveal Himself to us.

The world's wisdom failed Pharaoh, and it will fail us too if we lean on it alone. "Where is the wise person? ... Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?" (1 Cor 1:20). Humbly seek the wisdom that comes from God, for only He can reveal what our own minds cannot reach.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I recognize the limits of human wisdom and expertise?
2. Where am I leaning on my own cleverness instead of seeking God?
3. How can I humbly seek the wisdom that comes from God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I confess the limits of my own wisdom. For the things that matter most, I need You to reveal what my mind cannot reach. Give me the humility to seek the wisdom that comes from You. Amen.
